title: El Niño and Saharan Dust Silence Atlantic Hurricane Season
summary: The basin has only seen three named storms since the start of hurricane season in June, a trio of weak and largely disheveled tropical storms. An average Atlantic hurricane season produces an overall ACE of 122.5.
